notes_for_experiment_agent: No executable experiment is possible with the current pipeline outputs. The Schema Agent loaded zero files and zero rows due to SSL certificate verification failures across all attempted URLs. Beyond the technical loading failure, a substantive review of the 12 candidate datasets identified by the Dataset Agent confirms that none contain the data required to test the hypothesis: Argentine youth football registration counts disaggregated by province, age cohort, gender, and time (monthly or quarterly, 2018-2025). The available datasets consist of European club salary data (Capology), FIFA World Cup match-level statistics and results, individual player performance records (Messi), World Cup social media discourse labels, and a weather model comparison file. None of these sources include youth registration or enrollment data from the Argentine Football Association (AFA), provincial sports ministries, or municipal youth leagues. A new Dataset Agent run is required with targeted queries for: (1) AFA youth registration statistics or annual reports, (2) Argentine provincial sports ministry open data portals (e.g., datos.gob.ar), (3) INDEC demographic and sports participation surveys, (4) UNESCO or World Bank youth sports participation indicators for Argentina, and (5) academic supplementary datasets referenced in the mega-event legacy literature. SSL certificate issues must also be resolved before any GitHub-hosted CSV can be ingested.
